project_info.theme: Traction control stability in uncertain weather
project_info.color_palette: Rainy Blue, Electric Cyan, Red, White, Wet Asphalt Gray

main_subject.detail: A red Toyota Corolla Cross corners across a wet reflective road in rainy weather, with a glowing cyan ring around the front wheel and a circular traction-control scan graphic under the car.
main_subject.style: Photoreal safety-tech automotive poster with rainy road realism, holographic driving-assist effects, and clean feature-led typography.

composition_elements.text:
TOYOTA
HE THONG TRC
THOI TIET KHO DOAN? BAM DUONG VUNG HON
Move your world
items: Top Left: White Toyota logo over deep blue rainy sky.
Top Center: Cyan gradient headline bar 'HE THONG TRC' with large white subheadline 'THOI TIET KHO DOAN? BAM DUONG VUNG HON'.
Bottom Left: Wet reflective roadway with ripples and spray beneath the tires.
Bottom Right: Handwritten white 'Move your world'.
Center/Background: Red Corolla Cross in three-quarter front view, rainy skyline, blurred trees, and glowing traction-circle graphics.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Soft storm light, wet reflections, tire spray, subtle rain streaks, cyan holographic glow around wheel and road-contact area.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: The wet road, rain mood, and blue TRC visualization are essential. Keep the car planted and stable rather than drifting wildly; this image sells controlled grip in bad weather, not speed-racing.
